name: Quill USD
oneLiner: USDQ is Quill's Liquity-v2 fork on Scroll, minted from user-set interest CDPs against wETH, wstETH, weETH, and SCR collateral.
collateral: wETH, wstETH, weETH, and SCR in overcollateralized CDP markets on Scroll
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with user-set interest rates and direct on-chain redemption for underlying collateral; Stability Pools absorb liquidations per collateral market

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: USDQ is an EIP-1967/UUPS-style proxy whose implementation is controlled through the Quill AccessManager. No active direct blacklist or freeze function was confirmed, but the holder-facing token surface is mutable.

mintAuthority.summary: USDQ is minted only when users borrow against overcollateralized CDPs (wETH/wstETH/weETH/SCR) in Quill's immutable Liquity-v2 (BOLD) fork on Scroll; mint is restricted to the registered branch contracts and no admin can mint or freeze the token.

controls.label: Liquity-v2 BoldToken branch minters (BorrowerOperations/ActivePool/StabilityPool)
controls.evidence: Quill is an exclusive Liquity-v2 fork; per the Liquity-v2 BoldToken design, mint/burn rights are fixed to the registered per-branch protocol contracts at deployment and the token is non-upgradeable, so no owner/admin can mint outside CDP borrowing or freeze holders. QUILL governance only directs collateral incentives, not core minting.

review.evidence: Quill is a Liquity-v2 (BOLD codebase) fork on Scroll; minting follows the immutable Liquity-v2 model where users mint USDQ by borrowing against overcollateralized troves and redemption is permissionless. Prior Pharos review confirmed the token has no freeze/blacklist/seizure/proxy-upgrade surface. Renouncement here is grounded in the documented, audited immutable Liquity-v2 architecture (mint confined to registered branch contracts, non-upgradeable core), not an independent on-chain owner() read.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm on-chain that the BoldToken branch addresses are locked and no setBranchAddresses/owner authority remains active for 0xdb9e8f82d6d45fff803161f2a5f75543972b229a.
